name: ApprovalRouteDesigner
tagline: The Approval Route Designer lets you set up who has to approve a request, in which order, and from which amount - right on the record.
description: The Approval Route Designer lets you set up who has to approve a request, in which order, and from which amount - right on the record. Each step has a name, one or more approvers, an approval rule, an amount from which the step applies, a service level (SLA) in working days and an optional escalation contact.
features: Working-day SLAs and escalation contacts, templates, validation
A what-if route preview with estimated sign-off date
